hypothesis.name: Kneser
evidence: receivers = 560 and all degrees equal 286 (degree_min = degree_max = 286, regular), consistent with a Kneser graph
spectrum is integral with only 4 distinct eigenvalues: 286, 11, -1, -66 (multiplicities 1, 104, 440, 15), as expected for a vertex-transitive family

reply.analysis: Proven: bracket [105, 105] for 560 receivers. The lower bound 105 is an independent set; the upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_5 of length 105, with independent_set, code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all true. Only 1 code was tried. Against baselines: CP-SAT alpha also proved 105 (1.77 s), and the earlier kushagra_agent reached 105/105 in 0.13 s, faster than this agent's 30.06 s wall time, which is almost all LLM time (29.93 s) versus 0.138 s compute. The cover baselines did not close (CP-SAT cover 300 unproven, fractional 160 unproven), F2 min-rank only reached 104. Nothing suspicious.
